operations.text:
/* v1.3.23 bookings + queue positions */
.booking-groups{display:grid;gap:12px;padding:0 24px 110px}.booking-group{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden}.booking-group summary{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:16px;cursor:pointer}.booking-group summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.booking-group summary>span:first-child{display:grid;gap:3px}.booking-group summary small{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}.booking-group-body{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 12px 14px;display:grid;gap:8px}.booking-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;border-radius:14px;background:var(--soft)}.booking-row>div{display:grid;gap:3px;min-width:0}.booking-row small{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}.queue-position{width:36px;min-width:36px;height:36px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:12px;background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:950;font-size:12px}.payment-help{display:grid;gap:12px}.duplicate-player-card{display:grid;gap:12px}@media(max-width:420px){.booking-groups{padding-left:16px;padding-right:16px}.booking-row{align-items:flex-start}}
